identity_cost.detail: registration at https://portal.azvps.vn/register asks for a full name, an email, a phone number and a password; the phone input carries the required attribute and its dial-code selector lists countries worldwide with VN +84 the default, while tax code and company name are optional ('nếu có'). A 'Đăng ký với Google' button offers an OAuth path; its fields are unverified behind a sign-up. The order flow then needs the account before any payment step: the plan's order page reads 'Bạn cần đăng nhập hoặc tạo tài khoản ở bước tiếp theo.' and names only a billing cycle ('Chu kỳ thanh toán'), no card, transfer or wallet. Hold amount: not published on https://portal.azvps.vn/store/vps/cheap-2, https://azvps.vn/dieu-khoan-su-dung/ or https://azvps.vn/chinh-sach-bao-mat/. Charged or verified: not published on those pages. Prepaid and virtual cards: not published.

record.confidence_note: the prices are parsed from the vendor's page HTML; registration is read from the sign-up form (name, email, phone); the payment rails sit behind the account and are unverified.
